analysis:
The only changed behavior in these units is SSDPrefixCache.swift:1773-1778: LRU victim selection and retirement-result interpretation move from an inline loop into SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.evictOldest. The caller retains the safe-root gate, routes deletion through retireIndexedEntries, and increments eviction statistics only when freed bytes are positive. No concrete regression is established by this delegation alone. Integration must examine the changed helper to verify bounded victim traversal, skipping undeletable entries, stopping on externalChange, and returning genuinely freed indexed bytes; these properties underpin T-041 disk-budget enforcement and serving availability.
Examined surrounding donation, staging, sidecar and retirement paths. Donation preserves scoped HMAC lookup tags and adoption/staging limits (862-945); staging retains model/layout/tag binding checks, streaming limits, cancellation and reservation-release paths (1369-1571). Retirement still uses the removal lock, safe-root/ownership checks and external-removal reconciliation (1785-1835). These paths are unchanged in the complete range map, so their existing contracts are not reported as new issues. No changes to authorization, attestation, wire encryption or billing are visible here. The helper implementation and its interactions with the index and box-wide budget caller are outside this supplied source scope; their review is required before concluding that the LRU refactor preserves T-041 mitigations.
